name: Dixon Technologies

snapshot.about: Provider of electronics manufacturing services (EMS) across mobiles, IT hardware, telecom, home appliances, and lighting.

narrative: Management delivered strong growth with Q1 FY27 revenue of 15,548 crore and profit of 718 crore. However, EBITDA margin of 3.0% diverges from their target of 4.0% to 4.5%, and FY27 telecom guidance was trimmed from 7,500-8,000 crore to 6,700-7,000 crore.
